dependencies.completion_predicate: Under existing Execution Coordination and Invocation Runtime ownership, the non-scripted WorkerProvider path durably retains and reads back attributable role/invocation/attempt/contract/candidate outcome evidence across restart. criteria: Under existing Execution Coordination / Invocation Runtime ownership and after K1 proof, exercise durable role routing with distinct producer/verifier/closure invocations, exact candidate custody, canonical verifier rejection -> IMPLEMENT repair, remaining attempt/budget enforcement, trusted REVIEW verdict, and actual closure receipts. material_failure_classes: Producer success publishes/correlates the exact candidate and advances only to VERIFY; it cannot mechanically collapse through REVIEW/ACCEPT/DONE.
A distinct independent verifier invocation evaluates the retrieved exact candidate; rejection records findings and returns to IMPLEMENT under remaining attempt/budget policy.
Verifier acceptance proceeds through canonical REVIEW/ACCEPT and closure records only actual attributable closure receipts.
Missing, duplicate, stale or miscorrelated role/candidate/outcome evidence holds the affected transition despite process success.
Deterministic and real workers share WorkerProvider/result-correlation boundaries; no test lifecycle shortcut or parallel RoleOutcomeRecord state owner is introduced.
non_claims: No live/shared-profile activation is authorized by K2 local proof.
No new lifecycle owner or sidecar outcome state subsystem is created.

candidate_custody.policy: Future PRODUCER pins contract/input/baseline/profile and candidate branch+full SHA; publishes candidate to configured authorized remote and records exact branch/SHA on the Issue before RESULT=VERIFY. Fresh independent verifier retrieves that exact SHA in its own worktree; retain retrieval and verdict receipts.
candidate_custody.closure: Retain actor-owned branch/worktree through required closure; disposition LANDED, DISCARDED or PARKED with durable blocker. No direct main push by a BIU worker.
candidate_custody.current_artifact: Candidate specification only; no Issue, branch publication, implementation commit or worker invocation created by Phase 12.

landing: SWF-19: normal merge exact accepted candidate SHA; no pull request.
stop_condition: Hold this BIU on unmet dependency proof, unbound budget/custody, authority gap/gate, source revision mismatch, unavailable evidence, failing discriminating probe or conflicting ownership. Preserve unrelated completed proof.
escalation_condition: Return a genuine interface or authority conflict to its named existing owner; do not create a new owner or sidecar subsystem.
Hold on missing K1 proof, unavailable independent-verifier custody/readback, failing lifecycle discrimination, or unbound execution allocation.
readiness: fresh native Agent Ready assessment of this exact work-unit revision required before READY; no release authority
